# Mapa y filtros

## Mapa (EJEMPLO) {orientation="fill"}

```{python}
#| fig-cap: "DATOS DE EJEMPLO — ubicaciones sintéticas."

import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px

df = pd.read_csv("data/example_sites.csv")
fig = px.scatter_geo(
    df,
    lat="latitude",
    lon="longitude",
    color="technology",
    size="capacity_mw",
    hover_name="site_id",
    title="EJEMPLO: mapa Living Lab",
    scope="south america",
)
fig.update_layout(margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=40, b=0))
import plotly.io as pio
from IPython.display import Image
png = pio.to_image(fig, format="png", width=900, height=420, scale=1)
Image(png)
```

## Filtro OJS (EJEMPLO) {orientation="fill"}

```{ojs}
sites = [
  {site_id: "EX-101", region: "Andes", technology: "solar", capacity_mw: 3.5},
  {site_id: "EX-102", region: "Andes", technology: "wind", capacity_mw: 5.0},
  {site_id: "EX-201", region: "Caribbean", technology: "solar", capacity_mw: 2.2},
  {site_id: "EX-202", region: "Caribbean", technology: "biomass", capacity_mw: 1.8}
]
```

```{ojs}
viewof regionFilter = Inputs.select(
  ["All", "Andes", "Caribbean"],
  {label: "Región (filtro EJEMPLO)"}
)
```

```{ojs}
filteredSites = regionFilter === "All"
  ? sites
  : sites.filter((d) => d.region === regionFilter)
```

```{ojs}
Inputs.table(filteredSites, {width: 640})
```
